tabs.content:
Sensordata
| join kind=leftouter (
    dim_Location
    | project sensor_id, location_id, location_name, pollutant=parameter, units
) on sensor_id
| project timestamp_utc, sensor_id, location_id, location_name, pollutant, units, value, lat, lon
| order by timestamp_utc desc
tabs.title: NewData

tabs.content:
.set-or-append Sensordata_silver <|
Sensordata
| where todatetime(timestamp_utc) >= startofday(now())
| join kind=leftouter (
    dim_Location
    | project sensor_id, location_id, location_name, pollutant_code = parameter
) on sensor_id
| join kind=leftouter ( 
    dim_pollutant
    | project pollutant_code = parameter_name, pollutant_name = display_name, preferred_unit = units
) on pollutant_code
// Stage 1: Convert timestamp
| extend timestamp = todatetime(timestamp_utc)
// Stage 2: Derive hour, day, and month
| extend
    hour_of_day = datetime_part("hour", timestamp),
    day_of_month = format_datetime(timestamp, 'd'),
    month = format_datetime(timestamp, 'MM') // Full month name, e.g., "August"
// Stage 3: Pollution category classification
| extend
    pollution_category = case(
        pollutant_name == "PM2.5" and value <= 12.0, "Good",
        pollutant_name == "PM2.5" and value <= 35.4, "Moderate",
        pollutant_name == "PM2.5" and value <= 55.4, "Unhealthy for Sensitive",
        pollutant_name == "PM2.5" and value <= 150.4, "Unhealthy",
        pollutant_name == "PM2.5", "Very Unhealthy",
        "Unknown"
    )
| project
    timestamp, hour_of_day, day_of_month, month,
    location_id, location_name, sensor_id,
    pollutant_name, value, preferred_unit, pollution_category,
    lat, lon
| order by timestamp desc
tabs.title: Silver_transformation

tabs.content:
.create table Fact_sensorLoadDaily (
    event_date: date,           // Partitioning field (date-only from timestamp)
    location_id: int,           // Unique location ID from OpenAQ
    location_name: string,      // Human-readable location
    sensor_id: int,             // Unique sensor ID
    pollutant_name: string,      // e.g., PM2.5, NO2, O3, etc.
    value: real,                // Sensor reading for the day
    preferred_unit: string,      // Unit like μg/m³ or ppm
    lat: real,                  // Latitude of station
    lon: real                   // Longitude of station
)

.create table FactSensor_calc (
    event_date: string,
    sensor_id: int,
    location_id: int,
    pollutant_name: string,
    value: real,
    PreviousValue: real,
    DailyChange: real,
    MovingAverage7Day: real,
    lat: real,
    lon: real
)
tabs.title: FactTable

tabs.content:
.set-or-append Fact_sensorLoadDaily <|
Sensordata_silver
| extend event_date = startofday(timestamp)
| where event_date == startofday(now())
| project
    event_date = startofday(timestamp),
    location_id = toint(location_id),
    location_name,
    sensor_id = toint(sensor_id),
    pollutant_name,
    value,
    preferred_unit,
    lat,
    lon
| order by event_date
tabs.title: Fact_sensorLoadDaily

tabs.content:
.append FactSensor_calc<|
Fact_sensorLoadDaily
| where isnotempty(trim(' ', pollutant_name))
and event_date == format_datetime(now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') // ✅ Only today's data
| summarize
    value = avg(value)
    by event_date, sensor_id, location_id, pollutant_name, lat, lon
| extend event_date_dt = todatetime(event_date)
| order by sensor_id, pollutant_name, event_date_dt asc
| serialize
| extend PreviousValue = iif(sensor_id == prev(sensor_id) and pollutant_name == prev(pollutant_name), prev(value), real(null))
| extend DailyChange = iif(isnotnull(PreviousValue), value - PreviousValue, real(null))
| extend MovingAverage7Day = iif(
    isnull(prev(value, 6)) or
    sensor_id != prev(sensor_id,1) or sensor_id != prev(sensor_id,2) or sensor_id != prev(sensor_id,3) or
    sensor_id != prev(sensor_id,4) or sensor_id != prev(sensor_id,5) or sensor_id != prev(sensor_id,6) or
    pollutant_name != prev(pollutant_name,1) or pollutant_name != prev(pollutant_name,2) or pollutant_name != prev(pollutant_name,3) or
    pollutant_name != prev(pollutant_name,4) or pollutant_name != prev(pollutant_name,5) or pollutant_name != prev(pollutant_name,6),
    real(null),
    round((value + prev(value, 1) + prev(value, 2) + prev(value, 3) + prev(value, 4) + prev(value, 5) + prev(value, 6)) / 7, 2)
)
| extend DailyChange = round(DailyChange, 2), MovingAverage7Day = round(MovingAverage7Day, 2)
| extend event_date = format_datetime(event_date_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') // Normalize for consistency
| project
    event_date, sensor_id, location_id, pollutant_name,
    value, PreviousValue, DailyChange, MovingAverage7Day,
    lat, lon
tabs.title: FactSensor_calc
